text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three headed toward the remote 
tourist spot, the "Blue Great Pit." 
After trekking relentlessly down an empty 
path toward the coast...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"How lovely~! 
The sound of the waves echoes so nicely, 
and the breeze feels wonderful~♪"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Let's get right to it! Today's lucky 
direction is... this way! 
And the pose will be Copa-tastic☆ How's 
this look!?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, the lighting over there is... No, 
let's just try it first! 
No point overthinking it!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hrmmm... Does it look kind of flat? 
Even though it's such a pretty place..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Hrmmm... 
I knew it, maybe... No, never mind..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hm? What is it, what is it? 
Do you have a great idea!?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Tarumae-chan. 
Whatever you're thinking is just fine, you 
know."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, let's hear it!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Well, um... it's just a small detail, 
but... 
Standing there puts you right against the 
light, so maybe that's why..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! You're right!? 
But, but, I really don't wanna give up the 
lucky direction..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Then how about 'shooting FROM the 
lucky direction'? 
Instead of shooting AT it?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's a fantastic idea! 
Tarumae, are you a genius or what?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "It's just common sense! Geez..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"No, it really is amazing~! You're just so 
thoughtful, Tarumae, 
and you notice so many things the rest of 
us completely miss!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Things they miss... Ah...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're always thinking about things twice 
as much as the rest of us, aren't you, 
Tarumae-chan? 
There are surely so many details you 
notice that we don't.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"That's why things like this happen too... 
Because 'that's just who Tarumae-chan 
is.'"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Acute-san said that too...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
That's just... who I am..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Like a surging Azure Dragon... 
HO-WATAHHH! High-Speed☆Spinning Burst 
Shot! 
――Mgh!? Oh no~, it's completely blurred!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what are you doing?! 
Stop messing around and take this 
seriously!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh, I am totally serious~! 
I was just trying to capture a sense of 
speed... heheh☆"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, how about taking it extra 
slow instead? 
When I was little, there used to be those 
stop-motion doll animations, you see~."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that sounds fun...! I never would've 
thought of that. 
You really know a lot about retro stuff, 
Acute-san!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu♪ 
When it comes to things like this, I know 
quite a bit, I'll have you know."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Woah... nice! 
Rickey, you actually have pretty good 
taste, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Fufufu~n♪ I'm pretty confident in my 
aesthetic eye! 
My family home was packed with lucky 
ornaments and paintings, after all~☆"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui... aside, this fluttering effect 
looks really amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"(This is great... It keeps getting better 
and better! 
Ideas I'd never come up with on my own 
just keep popping up...!)"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What is it, Tarumae-chan?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I... I just thought of something too, if 
that's okay!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Of cooourse!! 
What is it, tell us!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Um, it's a pose I saw on Umastagram 
before! 
Acute-san, stand over there, Rickey, you 
go there, and then――"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Tarumae~☆ Is this spot okay? 
Setting the timer! 5 seconds left! Ready, 
set!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"My goodness! Ufufufufu! 
Tarumae-chan, how in the world did you 
come up with something like this?!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I do study how to take aesthetic photos as 
a local idol, after all. 
Pfft... This is really...! Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You really are amazing, Tarumae! 
You're so reliable and knowledgeable... 
You have everything I don't!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everything you don't...? But Rickey, 
you're plenty amazing yourself.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really? But while you were gone, things 
were so tough! 
Neither Acute-san nor I could deliver our 
lines properly at all...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's just...! Rickey, you're great just 
being Rickey. 
And Acute-san is...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Besides... so am I!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Fufufu... That's right. 
That's so true, Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Acute-san, back then, I didn't 
understand what you meant at all...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um...! Could you do that thing for me? 
That "Fighting Spirit Shoulder Pat" you 
always do before a race!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you want one? 
I'm usually the one on the receiving end, 
but... if you insist—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whack! Smack! Whack!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhhh... Alright! 
I'm gonna keep at it! We're sure to get 
some great shots tonight too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...! Rickey☆ Happy☆ Super OK☆☆☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—Brrr, so chilly. The battery's almost 
empty, too. 
Let's do the mellow version one last time!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! —Look, ain't it pretty?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Every single star is sparkling...
